opportunities.name: Sandstorm orbit
opportunities.objective: Keep the AP-scaled storm touching a durable target while Q remains a threat.
opportunities.mechanic: R deals target-max-health magic damage with an AP ratio each second; E has 0.6 AP upfront and 0.12 AP per tick. Cosmic Drive can turn this magic contact into movement while Liandry and Bloodletter reward ability damage. W restricts escape; this is an AP contact experiment rather than a claim that E armor shred helps the storm.
opportunities.requiredState: R ready; target remains inside its radius and E for a measured interval.
opportunities.failure: Kiting outside the storm or losing Q pressure can outweigh all burn damage.
opportunities.test: Measure R contact seconds and E ticks against a moving high-health target; repeat without Cosmic.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: E armor reduction does not amplify E or R magic damage.

opportunities.name: Finite-stack siphon recovery
opportunities.objective: Test whether a protected Q cadence replenishes enough health to survive a duel.
opportunities.mechanic: Soul Eater supplies lifesteal and Q is explicitly an attack with a recorded finite stack contribution. R halves Q cooldown; Iceborn supplies a Spellblade attack and a local slow between Wither windows. Visage increases healing received and Sundered Sky adds a conditional first-attack heal.
opportunities.requiredState: Fix Q stacks, target defenses and first-hit item readiness; use R and actual Q attacks.
opportunities.failure: Anti-heal, disengage or excessive armor makes recovery insufficient.
opportunities.test: Log healing per Q and Q attacks landed over one R at two finite stack counts.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The source CritDamage calculation leaves stack damage outside the crit multiplier; do not multiply all stacks by Sundered Sky.

ruledOut.reason: Q CritDamage preserves BuffStacks separately from the crit-multiplied AD/base expression.

unknowns: Soul Eater tooltip is cross-referenced; inspected calculation has level breakpoints. Sundered Sky Q packet and lifesteal eligibility need live checks.

builds.name: Sandstorm orbit
builds.summary: Keep the AP-scaled storm touching a durable target while Q remains a threat.

Cosmic Drive can turn this magic contact into movement while Liandry and Bloodletter reward ability damage. W restricts escape; this is an AP contact experiment rather than a claim that E armor shred helps the storm.
testPlan: Required state: R ready; target remains inside its radius and E for a measured interval.
Measure R contact seconds and E ticks against a moving high-health target; repeat without Cosmic.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Kiting outside the storm or losing Q pressure can outweigh all burn damage.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: E armor reduction does not amplify E or R magic damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Liandry's Torment, Cosmic Drive, Bloodletter's Curse, Riftmaker, Spirit Visage, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Nasus becomes empowered in the sandstorm for 15 seconds, increasing his maximum Health by [300 / 450 / 600] and Armor and Magic Resistance by [40 / 55 / 70].

While the storm rages, nearby enemies take [0.03 / 0.04 / 0.05 + (0.0001) × AP] of their maximum Health as magic damage each second and Siphoning Strike has a [50]% reduced Cooldown.
Nasus ages a champion, Slowing them by [35]%, increasing to [47 / 59 / 71 / 83 / 95]% over [5] seconds. Their Attack Speed is also reduced by [75]% of the Slow.
